name: Golden Image Label
description: The raster document behind the RO-111 golden artifacts: a JPEG drawn into a 40 x 16 mm box with preserve_aspect_ratio, so the image XObject, its /DCTDecode stream, the fitted and centred box and the /Do placement are pinned by exact bytes, and a 2 x 2 indexed PNG stretched into an 8 x 8 mm box, so the Indexed colour space, the depth-wide Decode and the unfiltered rows PostScript paints are pinned too. A frame rectangle pins the JPEG's placement against it, and the conformance check reads the indexed picture's painted quadrants.
